title: Witnesses split up and reassigned

tellings.quote:
what did they do with
Terry and Toby split them reassign them
you can't talk to each other what what
do they do with with Mario woods and
Michael Johnson same thing

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, says that when military people witness something unexplained they are split up and sent to different posts so they cannot talk to each other. He gives as examples two people he calls Terry and Toby, and two others named Mario Woods and Michael Johnson, without naming a source. If true, it would show the military working to keep witnesses from comparing their stories.
